start_score_decomposition.constants: start: level-1 capital (100), territory 3x3 = 9 tiles (180), 5x5 = 25 explored tiles (125) -> 405 before unit/tech/level
start_score_decomposition.verified_by: validate_dataset.py reproduces 14 of the 15 wiki start scores exactly from components (all except Kickoo, C5); the PE start packages for Ai-Mo/Luxidoor/Kickoo do not (C1,C2,C5).
start_score_decomposition.corner_rule: SC: a capital whose 5x5 reveal contains a corner starts 5 points lower (corner tile not revealed).
start_score_decomposition.implication: The REAL initial reveal around a capital is 5x5 (25 tiles). PE reveals only the 3x3 territory + unit radius 1 (C21).

units.v: exactly one unit in the capital

capital_income.note: DEV: bot baseline +2 stars/turn from capital

resolved._note: Best current belief; confidence reflects agreement between sources AND the arithmetic score check.

AiMo.note: NamuWiki: 2025 patch changed Ai-Mo from Meditation to Philosophy + Hypnotist(Mind Bender), -33% tech cost. Fandom Ai-Mo/Tribes pages and the 615 score are pre-patch. 730 = 405+25+300 by formula; PE's own commented table also says 730.

Luxidoor.note: NamuWiki: Apr 2021 capital cut to level 2; Nov 2025 patch cut stars to 2 and RESTORED level 3. Fandom score 465 (level 2) is pre-Nov-2025. Level 3 = 515 by formula = PE. Wall: unconfirmed. Namu guaranteed-near-capital list: 2 fruit, 2 animal, 1 crop, 2 fish, 1 iron (8 tiles).

Polaris.note: 530 = 405+25(Mooni cost 5)+100(T1) by formula. Wiki Score page may be pre-2025; PE says 630. Unresolved - version drift possible.

Cymanti.note: 630 = 405+25(Shaman)+200(T2 Farming). NamuWiki also lists Farming (mushroom farming) and Shaman/Warrior ambiguity; PE has Shaman but no start tech.

Kickoo.note: Fishing+Warrior = 515 by formula and NamuWiki lists nothing else. The fandom score 615 is unexplained and possibly from an older version. Lean 515.

Aquarion: no start tech; starts with Mermaid (amphibious)
all units can move on water; land slow unless flooded
can build on water & place monuments on ocean
unique: Aqua Farm, Atoll, Flood/Fill, Tridention, Shark, Puffer, Jelly, Crab(super)
Elyrion: start tech Forest Magic; Enchant Animal -> Polytaur; Sanctuary
'at least 2 animals' guaranteed near capital (Strategies page)
Polaris: terraforming instead of boats; captured territory turns to Polaris terrain and water freezes
Ice Bank (income, max level raised 8->10 in 2019 nerf), Outpost gives 1 pop (was 2)
Cymanti: spores replace crops; >=2 spores guaranteed at start
Shaman boost: +0.5 attack, +1 move until it acts (WK Combat)
8 unique units, 6 unique skills, 4 unique buildings
no Ports/Rafts; Organization doesn't reveal crops
special_tribe_mechanics.conf: low-med (summaries only; PE has unit stats but not these mechanics)
